Existing capability registry mentions allowed top-level kernel/os families but current capability-home mapping is not explicit enough for execution lanes.
progression_action: Define the kernel/os registry placement and ownership boundaries before implementing runtime replacement lanes. SUCCESS=Linux ABI and runtime work has a non-oya/non-cloud home with explicit owners and promotion gates; FAILURE=runtime work drifts into delivery-fabric product contracts or ad-hoc cloud/oya paths.

title: Implement source-tracked parity harness for Kubernetes, Argo, GitHub Actions, GitLab, legacy plugin-controller CI, Snyk, Trivy, driftctl, Linux ABI, and OCI/CRI
current_state: Research artifacts map best-in-class references, but no executable ParityTarget registry or differential fixture harness exists in this branch yet. Without it, source repos cannot be religiously tracked and parity claims stay unverifiable.
progression_action: Create ParityTarget schema, upstream ref rows, golden fixtures, differential tests, freshness transitions, and replacement scoring. SUCCESS=source changes reopen parity rows and at least one executable fixture per reference family proves behavior; FAILURE=feature parity remains a narrative matrix without runnable evidence.
